facts.fact: Mauritius's Computer Misuse and Cybercrime Act 2003 (Act No. 22 of 2003) was passed by the National Assembly on 15 July 2003 and assented to on 30 July 2003; it creates offences such as unauthorised access, interception and electronic fraud.

note: Document states a 2003 Act; its later repeal is not in the text itself.
